tools.name: connect_atwork_mcp
tools.description: How to connect an AI assistant (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client) to Atwork's remote MCP server, with the endpoint and per-client steps.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get Atwork's current plans with monthly and annual per-seat prices (USD) and what each plan includes.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search the Atwork blog. Returns matching posts with a summary, publish date and link.

query.description: Words to match against blog post titles, summaries and tags. Empty returns the first results.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search the Atwork help center. Returns matching articles with a summary and link.

query.description: Words to match against help article titles, summaries and tags. Empty returns the first results.

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search Atwork's public template catalog (CRMs, project trackers, content calendars…). Returns name, tagline, categories and a link per template.

query.description: Words to match against template names, taglines and categories. Empty returns the first results.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Open Atwork's free signup, optionally starting from a template slug returned by search_templates. Navigates this tab to the signup page.
